stem.text: A man of mass $75.2\,\text{kg}$ uses a set of weighing scales to measure his mass three times. He obtains the following readings.
Which statement describes the precision and accuracy of the weighing scales?

A.text: not precise to $\pm 0.1\,\text{kg}$ and accurate to $\pm 0.1\,\text{kg}$

B.text: not precise to $\pm 0.1\,\text{kg}$ and not accurate to $\pm 0.1\,\text{kg}$

D.text: precise to $\pm 0.1\,\text{kg}$ and not accurate to $\pm 0.1\,\text{kg}$
